name: framelens-mobile
description: 影析 FrameLens 移动端：全平台视频/图片解析（复用桌面端同一套解析引擎）

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:release:full: npm run model:embed && npm run android:release
